scripts.text: You're carrying too many items in your inventory. Visit Kafra storage and try again.
scripts.translation: 您的物品栏中携带的物品过多。请前往卡普拉仓库整理后再试。

scripts.text: You cannot proceed because you're overweight.

[Driller]
My job is to drill a card slot into RWC Memorial accessories.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
我的工作是为RWC纪念饰品钻出卡片槽。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
I'm sorry but you don't have any item equipped on your right accessory position.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
很抱歉，您的右侧饰品栏没有装备任何物品。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
My job is to drill a card slot into RWC Memorial accessories. Moreover, I only treat ^ff0000pure items^000000, or those which have not been enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
我的工作是为RWC纪念饰品钻出卡片槽。此外，我只处理^ff0000纯净物品^000000，即未进行过附魔的物品。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
However, I can see that the accessory you are wearing on the right side cannot be treated. Please equip a RWC Memorial accessory.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
不过，我发现您右侧佩戴的饰品无法处理。请装备一件RWC纪念饰品。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
You should also know that making a card slot it extremely dangerous. ^ff0000Chances to succeed are about 50%.^000000 Do you wish to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
您应该知道，钻出卡片槽是极其危险的。^ff0000成功率大约只有50%^000000。您确定要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Driller]
I can't identify the accessory item you're wearing on your right hand. I can't work on it.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
我无法识别您右手佩戴的饰品。我无法对它进行操作。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
This item has already been enchanted. I can't work on this as it is against the rules.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
这件物品已经附魔了。根据规定，我无法对它进行操作。

scripts.text:
[Driller]
Yay! Success! Your {0} now has a card slot. Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
耶！成功了！您的{0}现在有了卡片槽。快看看吧！

scripts.text:
[Driller]
Awww... Damn weak {0}... It broke during the procedure. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[钻探工]
哎呀...这该死的{0}太脆弱了...它在操作过程中损坏了。我很抱歉。

scripts.text: You are carrying too many items. Come back after you have organized your inventory.
scripts.translation: 您携带的物品过多。请在整理好物品栏后再来。

scripts.text: You cannot proceed because you're overweight.

[Goldberg]
Hello! I am in charge of enchanting RWC Memorial accessories with some mystic powers.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
你好！我负责为RWC纪念饰品赋予神秘力量。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
I'm sorry but you don't have any item equipped on your right accessory position.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
很抱歉，您的右侧饰品栏没有装备任何物品。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
However, I can see that the accessory you are wearing is not something I can work on. Please equip a RWC Memorial accessory.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
不过，我发现您佩戴的饰品不是我能处理的类型。请装备一件RWC纪念饰品。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Alright, then, see you next time...
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
好的，那我们下次再见...

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
I'm sorry, but I cannot work on the accessory you are currently wearing.
If you have equipped your RWC Memorial accessory on the left side, try to swap it to the right side.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
很抱歉，我无法为您当前佩戴的饰品进行附魔。
如果您将RWC纪念饰品装备在左侧，请尝试将其换到右侧。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Which enchantment would you like to infuse?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
您想要注入哪种附魔？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
^ff0000Be careful! There is about a 25% chance that the enchantment will fail. If this happens, the item will be destroyed.^000000 Which enchantment would you like to infuse?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
^ff0000请注意！附魔失败的概率约为25%。如果失败，物品将会被破坏。^000000您想要注入哪种附魔？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
^ff0000There is about a 25% chance that the enchantment will fail. If this happens, the item will be destroyed.^000000 Which enchantment would you like to infuse?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
^ff0000附魔失败的概率约为25%。如果失败，物品将会被破坏。^000000您想要注入哪种附魔？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Your accessory has received so many enchantments that I can hardly work on it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
您的饰品附魔次数过多，我几乎无法再对它进行操作了。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Alright, then, see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
好的，那我们下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
The power of the enchantment will be randomly chosen. ^ff0000Once infused, the enchantment cannot be removed.^000000 Shall we continue?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
附魔的强度将随机决定。^ff0000一旦附魔，就无法移除。^000000 要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Alright, then, see you next time...
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
好的，那我们下次再见...

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Do not take off your equipment while I'm working, okay?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
在我工作期间，请不要卸下装备，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
We have got a problem, let me check it up.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
我们遇到了一个问题，让我检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Oh gosh!
The item was not strong enough to bear the enchantment and thus got destroyed. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
天哪！
这件装备不够坚固，无法承受附魔，因此被破坏了。我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Oh... It looks like there was an instability of some sort between all the powers infused. This caused all the enchantments to vanish. It is a shame, but please try again!
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
哦... 看起来注入的各种力量之间出现了不稳定的情况。这导致所有附魔都消失了。很遗憾，请再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Great!
The enchantment is a success! It will be applied in socket No.^990000{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
太好了！
附魔成功！它将应用于第^990000{0}^000000号插槽。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
I will just initialize the enchant option without doing anything to the slotted card. You wanna continue?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
我只会初始化附魔选项，不会对已镶嵌的卡片做任何处理。要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
如果您改变主意，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
I'm sorry. But you don't have the RWC Initialization coupon. Can you check your inventory?
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
很抱歉。但是您没有RWC初始化券。请检查您的物品栏。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
Hm... this equipment is clean. I cannot initialize it if there's nothing! Check it again.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
嗯... 这件装备很干净。如果没有东西，我无法初始化它！请再检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Goldberg]
The enchant option in your item will be initialized.
scripts.translation:
[戈德伯格]
您物品上的附魔选项将被初始化。
